Subject: Private deployment onboarding: account & network readiness sweep

Sarah / Victor —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your private deployment. To keep the deployment on the planned timeline (targeting pilot infra week of 2027-03-08), please confirm the items below so our infra team can request the cloud interconnect and schedule the on-prem validation window. I attached our provisioning template and the on‑prem prereqs PDF for reference.

Quick checklist (please reply inline):
- Account & billing: do you have a cloud account owner and billing contact assigned? (name + email)
- Network CIDR(s): primary VPC CIDR and any secondary ranges we need to know (please list).
- NAT/Egress: will you provide a dedicated NAT gateway or should we plan for egress via your existing edge?
- Firewall rules: need explicit allow for outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai (34.212.18.7/32), and for installer endpoints (install.redwood.internal:443).
- Interconnect window: preferred maintenance window for BGP/session bring-up (provide two options).
- KMS/HSM: will keys be managed by you or Redwood for the pilot? (kms provider + contact)

Action: If you can fill in the attached provisioning template by EOD Friday (2027-02-19), Dev and Marissa will review and propose the engineering kickoff.

Attachments: network_provisioning_template.xlsx (fill+return), redwood_onprem_prereqs.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

We can do a 30min tech-check tomorrow at 13:00 PT if that works; otherwise early next week.

Sarah — quick follow up from the infra side (short list):

1) Inbound peering: for the pilot outbound-only is fine and simplifies firewall requirements. If you want low-latency bidirectional traffic later we can plan private peering in the production rollout.

2) MTU: we do not require jumbo frames for the pilot; standard 1500 MTU is fine. Please confirm if your team uses 9001 anywhere for storage backplanes — we will accommodate but need to know for BGP nexthop handling.

3) SNAT/persistent sessions: if you provide the NAT please allow a port range 1024–65535; if you want session affinity we can enable a sticky egress proxy (adds ~5–10ms).

4) Installer domains/IPs: installer.redwood.internal (DNS over HTTPS), bootstrap.redwood.com (34.212.18.7), artifacts.redwood.com (34.212.18.42). We'll share a larger allowlist in the doc link below.

I've scheduled a 30-minute tech-check with your network team for Fri 2027-02-19 13:00 PT / 21:00 UTC — invite sent to Derek + Andrew + Victor. Please confirm.

--
Dev Patel
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
